# Definition 
**Postpartum Endometritis** is infection of the uterine decidua. 

# Risk Factors 
- C-section 
- Prolonged ROM/Labor
- History of GBS infection

# Diagnosis 
Clinical, based on >2 of the following: 
- Fever >24 hours postpartum 
- Uterine tenderness 
- Purulent/malodorous discharge
